Do you know the hassle of having to remove strawberry stems, wasting half the fruit with a knife? This small and very useful 3D printable kitchen gadget is the perfect solution!

Thanks to its ergonomic shape and the small teeth on the tip, it allows you to "hug" the stem and remove it in a second with a simple rotary motion, leaving the strawberry intact and ready to enjoy. It's super lightweight, compact, and very easy to print.
